title: So much assembly and time required for a very unsatisfactory final product...
text:
So much assembly and time required for a very unsatisfactory final product.... I had gotten something similar before and it was shipped to me fully assembled, and made of real wood. Here's the link to that one: https://www.amazon.com/IOTXY-Bathroom-Storage-Cabinet-Container/dp/B07ZV5MV3Y/ref=cm_cr_arp_d_product_top?ie=UTF8

So when I saw the product listing to this cabinet, I quickly assumed it was a similar product. Boy was I wrong! This thing is all MDF, and the effort felt like putting together an Ikea product. Not that Ikea furniture are difficult, it's just the end result of Ikea furniture's are worth it. You will NOT feel that satisfaction after putting together this little dinky cabinet. Screws and camlocks galore, you need to be a handy person to complete this job. I'm a handy person, and I found problems along the way that made me wonder how a non-handy person could do this job. I think they'd give up. Pre-drilled screw holes were misaligned, magnetic hardware uses screws so small that they eventually lose their grip on the MDF. You need to tighten the camlocks during assembly or else it's hard to balance the thing, but then if you do tighten them, at the end you'll be surprised to find out you cannot side the backboard in flush. You need to go back and loosen the camlocks to slide the backs in. The final product is okay if you spent 10 to 20 minutes on this. But you'll be at this for a long time, and the final results won't make you feel that it was time well spent. If you absolutely need something like this, I would get the one in the link above. That one isn't without issues, but at least it comes to you fully assembled and is made of real wood.

I took pictures of the instructions, take a look at them. Because I had assumed this is something similar to the fully assembled cabinet in the above link, you can imagine how unprepared I was to see this manual. LOL! Nevertheless, I wasted a few hours on this thing, and like I said, the end result wasn't worth the time. So look at that manual and decided for yourself if you want this little cabinet bad enough.
